# Pranshu Nijhawan

> Principal Architect at McKinsey & Company. Owns the architecture of Promotion Advisor, a multi-tenant product in the Periscope suite, and co-built Platform AI, the agent platform every Periscope product deploys through.

The site is a single page: a hero with an enterprise architecture diagram, an About section with a McKinsey timeline, a skills map, a career ruler with every role since 2016, and contact details.
